entries.test: The Nobel citation and historical publications on back-propagation would establish what the citation credits and whether Hinton invented it.
entries.note: The proposition preserves the hedge about what the citation seems to indicate.
“Not clear” strengthens “not entirely clear.” Readers could disagree about sufficient clarity even with the same Nobel documentation.
“A slam dunk” expresses a judgment that the award is deserved.
The normalization drops “in my mind” from the ranking and broadens use by biologists to use across both fields. Widespread adoption is separately checkable, but the overall ranking is evaluative.

entries.test: DeepMind's published research and Hassabis's and Hinton's public statements through publication would show their advancement of neurosymbolic methods and comparative openness to competing approaches.
entries.note: The surrounding discussion gives “dogmatic” a concrete referent: willingness to pursue approaches beyond the favored neural-network tradition.

entries.test: AlphaFold2's published architecture, methods, and code would establish its neural and symbolic components and whether it operates as the single nucleotide-to-structure network described in the post.
entries.note: The source rejects a specific single-network nucleotide-to-structure pipeline. The normalization broadens this into an unrestricted denial that AlphaFold2 is end-to-end.

entries.test: The Nobel award history and technical descriptions of AlphaFold and earlier prize-winning work would establish whether this was the first award for neurosymbolic AI.
entries.note: “As far as I can tell” qualifies a historical assertion; it does not turn that assertion into rhetoric or an explicit probability claim.

entries.test: Public evaluations and deployment records available by publication would show whether any LLM provided a robust, highly reliable solution to a particular problem, alongside evidence of commercial returns and public prominence.
entries.note: “Main product” changes “most visible manifestation.” The sweeping denial of any reliable solution is empirically testable.

entries.test: Public interpretability research, error evaluations, and measurements of LLM electricity, water, and data requirements at publication would test the asserted limitations and resource demands.
entries.note: The language is emphatic, but it asserts concrete technical limitations and substantial resource requirements.
The surrounding discussion supports interpreting the new approach as moving beyond pure end-to-end networks. The central claim is a recommendation.
The normalization narrows general open-mindedness to a particular class of approaches. “Serve the field well” supplies no shared criterion for the predicted benefit.
